item.title: Samoan Chef Brings Flavors of Home to New Zealand’s Fine-Dining Scene
item.description: Food was at the heart of Henry Onesemo’s South Pacific island upbringing. Now, he’s bringing flavors of home to his Michelin-starred restaurant in New Zealand.

item.title: More Than 50 Killed in Yemen in One of the Deadliest 24 Hours of the War
item.description: Strikes show the heavy toll since fighting between the Houthis and the Saudi-backed government reignited in August, with civilians paying a heavy price.

item.title: Prosecutors Charge Paraguay’s Former President With Corruption
item.description: Santiago Peña was impeached, removed from office, placed under house arrest and charged with using his office to enrich himself after a bank with close ties to his administration went under.

item.title: Islamist Militant Attack Forces Patients to Flee Ebola Clinic in Congo
item.description: At least 48 people were killed in a brutal assault by a group loyal to the Islamic State, officials said. The area is a hot spot of the growing Ebola outbreak.

item.title: Why Winning Big Matters
item.description: The midterm elections in the United States and recent votes in Europe show how blowout victories can make results impossible to deny.
